notes.general_comments:
Most candidates work was neat and well presented. Candidates should always refer to the formula booklet
provided if in doubt of a specific formula.
Candidates should be reminded that an answer should be given to 3 significant figures unless otherwise
stated in the question. This means that they should work to at least 4 significant figures.
The questions that candidates found more accessible were 1, 2(i), 2(ii), 6(i) and 6(ii), whilst the questions
found more challenging were 5(ii), 6(iii) and 7(iii).
